system.description:
A hafted thrusting weapon — spear, quarterstaff or farmer's pitchfork — that keeps foes at arm's length.

Negative Traits: Heavy

Concealability: None

Damage: Two lethal health levels (bashing for a staff)

Availability: Resources x1 (N/A if Staff), Common

Special Ability: Staking (if wooden-tipped and sharpened), Two-Hand Requirement

Special Flaw: Any strike that misses requires the wielder to make a Simple Test; failure means the weapon strikes the wielder, causing full damage.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages), Rules, Systems and Drama
